scope: Private QtCore preparation only; production worker/page/UI unchanged.
parser_provenance: Source-derived grammar from original quality_result writer/getReportResultsString; unsafe legacy split/at/toDouble-default implementation is not reused.
intentional_safety_differences: Single project QC writer envelope only; multiple/nested project blocks, unknown/MDA/Formula and duplicate result types fail closed.
Signed/decimal/scientific C-locale numbers parsed without splitting their minus signs; invalid/missing/non-finite/overflow values retain error codes and NaN, never zero.
Original per-batch date DESC preserved; time DESC then row ID DESC explicitly completes same-date determinism. Previous batch still concatenated before current batch.
legacyTraceAtCounter preserves original reverse-index behavior only for independent comparison; no silent latest-point correction.
Unknown units or AssociationSnapshotOnly cannot produce converted display values or mixed history aggregation. Only explicitly declared per-row fixture or per-point stored provenance is accepted.
Invalid requested-result rows are counted/excluded from numeric aggregation; valid numeric rows with unknown units make aggregate unavailable rather than silently calculating a subset.
Core row/character budgets are private offline guardrails, not instrument specifications or response-budget acceptance.
caller_boundary: All supplied rows and per-row unit evidence must come from the same verified bound dataset. This pure value core does not authenticate a database/UUID or establish real-world unit provenance. Future worker integration must preserve the existing identity/reference contract.
cv_contract: The existing statistics CLI and this copied helper both expose signed legacyCvRatio=SD/(mean+1e-12), ratio-not-percent. Never multiply by100 for this CV field.
